Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Lovekush Kumar Mishra,Prabhakar Tripathi
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed in Court today, is taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the informant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.

3. The present second bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 272 of 2018,
under Section 363, 366, 376, 201, 302 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station Bah,
District
Agra with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
The first bail application of applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 13.01.2021.

sentences.text: 4. It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
The prosecution version that deceased was taken away by applicant on 02.06.2018 is wholly doubtful.
There is no eye witness of incident.

Referring to the postmortem report, it was submitted that the injuries sustained by the deceased are quite possible while she may have committed suicide and that the dead body of deceased was found in the well.

5. It was further submitted that the first bail application of applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 13.01.2021 and the trial court was directed to expedite the trial and to conclude the same preferably within a period of six months but despite that the trial has not been concluded so far.

Statement of PW-3 Rustam, recorded before the trial court, was referred and it was submitted that the marriage of deceased was fixed with some boy but she was not willing to marry and that may be the reason that she must have committed suicide.
Statement of other witnesses were referred and it was submitted that there is no credible evidence against the applicant.

It was further submitted that the applicant is in judicial custody since 07.06.2018, having no previous criminal history, and that, he has already undergone the detention of about five years and eight months.
Lastly, it was submitted that in case, applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.

6. Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for bail and argued that the first bail application of applicant has already been rejected by this Court on merits vide order dated 13.01.2021 and there is no new ground to entertain this second bail application.
It was submitted that there is evidence that deceased was taken away by the applicant on 02.06.2018 and after that her dead body was recovered on 03.06.2018.
The deceased was 'last seen' with the applicant.
There is sufficient evidence to show the involvement of applicant.

It was further submitted by learned counsel for the informant that during trial the prosecution evidence has already been concluded and the case is at the stage of statement of accused u/s 313 Cr.P.C.
7.
Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, gravity of the offence and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, no case for grant of bail is made out.
8. Accordingly, the instant second bail application filed on behalf of applicant is rejected.

9. However, keeping in view the period of detention of the applicant, the trial Court is again directed to expedite the trial and to decide the same expeditiously, preferably within a period of six months from the date of production/receipt of copy of this order.
10. A copy of this order be transmitted to the concerned trial court for necessary compliance.
